data.name: Sudharshan
data.gender_notes: Sudharshan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sudharshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sudharshana', which means 'auspicious' or 'prosperous'. It is also the name of a divine discus weapon, which is one of the eight weapons of Lord Vishnu. The name is believed to bring good luck and success in all endeavors. The name Sudharshan carries the meaning “Auspicious, Prosperous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sudharshan usually hope their child will grow to embody auspicious, prosperous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sudharshan is a symbol of divine protection, power, and auspiciousness. It represents the victory of good over evil and the attainment of spiritual success.
data.etymology: Sudharshan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Auspicious, Prosperous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudharshan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sudharshan is deeply rooted in Hindu culture and mythology. It is a name of reverence and auspiciousness, used not only as a personal name but also for various deities and entities. In Hindu art and literature, Sudharshan is often depicted as the disk weapon (Chakra) of Lord Vishnu, which he wields to protect the universe from evil forces. The weapon is known for its destructive power and its ability to bring balance and order to the cosmos.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Sudharshan represents the divine power of protection and purification. It reminds us of the presence and protection of Lord Vishnu and his role as the preserver of the universe. It also signifies the importance of seeking good fortune and prosperity through righteous means and actions. By invoking the name of Sudharshan, one can infuse a sense of positivity, strength, and resilience in one's life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sudharshan, derived from the Sanskrit words 'su' (good) and 'dharshan' (sight), signifies one who has an auspicious and divine vision. It also symbolizes the Sudarshan Chakra, a sacred weapon of Lord Vishnu, representing righteousness, protection, and destruction of evil.
